outgoing.name: Africa
outgoing.excerpt: In his journey he passed through large swathes of Europe, Asia, and Africa.

outgoing.name: Egypt
outgoing.excerpt: From there he went to Persia, then cut back across the Arabian Peninsula to Egypt and North Africa, returning to Spain in 1173.

outgoing.name: Europe
outgoing.excerpt: In his journey he passed through large swathes of Europe, Asia, and Africa.

outgoing.name: Geography
outgoing.excerpt: With his broad education and vast knowledge of languages, Benjamin of Tudela was a major figure in the history of geography and Jewish history.

outgoing.name: Marco Polo
outgoing.excerpt: His vivid descriptions of Asia preceded those of Marco Polo by one hundred years.

outgoing.name: North Africa
outgoing.excerpt: From there he went to Persia, then cut back across the Arabian Peninsula to Egypt and North Africa, returning to Spain in 1173.

outgoing.name: Spain
outgoing.excerpt: Benjamin of Tudela (flourished 12th century) was a medieval Spanish Jewish Rabbi, traveler and explorer.

outgoing.name: Syria
outgoing.excerpt: After visiting Rome and Constantinople, he set off across Asia, visiting Syria and Palestine before reaching Baghdad.
